items.html: When the upper Emanator began to create the world, He emanated, created, made, and did the four worlds ABYA. He began to sort the four above-mentioned kings that died. What was sorted from Him rose in the sanctity of the worlds, and what was not sorted remained a shell and dross. However, the essence of these dross and kings, their root is the first name BON. It is one Partzuf Adam from its Rosh to its Raglaim, containing corresponding shells from its Rosh to its Raglaim.
